mode: Window-free egui, CPU icon rasterization and lint checks only. No desktop, native-window or screenshot-preview launches.

color_gui.scope: Existing staged RGB/HSL/custom palette acceptance, invalid RGB, cancellation, secondary-target and responsive-dialog cases remain passing.

hover_gui.scope: Existing tooltip checks plus centered 40-point primary/32-point secondary wells at display scales 1 and 2. Each well shows one named RGB/hex tooltip after primary/secondary palette choices; arbitrary custom RGB gets a Custom color label. Color choices and secondary-dialog acceptance preserve document/history across repeated layout passes.

icon_unit.scope: All 88 registered icons parse and rasterize with transparency at 24/64/128 pixels; bounded cache and density selection pass. Edit Colors has null sheet coordinates and regenerates byte-identically.

limits: Color presentation moved into the palette module. Tool-color adoption, alpha retention, palette values and staged-dialog policy remain unchanged. Names reuse the existing palette labels; native color nomenclature/processing and rendered visual parity remain unqualified under the user restriction.
